help: Games render with the GPU, so GDI screen grabs are black.
Windows.Graphics.Capture (the `gfxcapture` filter of ffmpeg) gets the real frames of one window, even when another window covers it.
Many games talk to WASAPI directly, so a process-loopback capture is the only clean way to get the sound of the game alone.
Input goes through SendInput only while the game is the foreground window, so nothing leaks into other apps.
Never block the main thread of the game when you stop a recording.
Write .mkv, because it survives a kill.
NVENC H.264 tops out at 4096 px wide: for ultrawide, crop or use HEVC.
The crash reporter of a crashed game (BugSplat and others) can make Steam refuse to relaunch it: list it and kill it by PID.
Then mux: um video mux take1.mkv take1.audio.raw take1.json out.mp4

messages.platform: `um win` drives Windows games (native Windows or WSL). On Linux use xdotool or ydotool with ffmpeg x11grab or pipewire. On macOS use screencapture with ffmpeg avfoundation.
messages.noPid: no pid for audio capture (give --exe or --pid). Recording video only.
messages.noFfmpeg: no Windows ffmpeg with gfxcapture yet: run `um win setup`
messages.hdr: WARNING: Windows Auto HDR is on{exe}. On an HDR display the capture of an SDR game comes out washed out (brighter, shifted colours). Turn Auto HDR off for the game while you capture: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > (the game) > Auto HDR.
messages.noFrames: WARNING: no video frames were captured. gfxcapture delivers a frame only when the window redraws. A game that is paused, minimized or on a static menu gives nothing, and ffmpeg cannot react to `q` until a frame comes. Record while the game is rendering.

setup.help: install the PowerShell tools and a gfxcapture-capable ffmpeg (SHA-256 checked)

launch.help: start a game (exe path or --steam APPID), with its arguments after `--`

exe.help: executable name of the window, for example AoE2DE_s.exe (regex)

scale.help: also write a scaled copy (for example 0.33) that is cheap to look at

drive.help: send WinDrive commands to a game window

record.help: record a game window and its audio, to --out .mkv, .audio.raw and .json
record.usage: --out BASE [--exe NAME | --hwnd N | --title RE] [--seconds S] [--fps N] [--no-audio] [--crop L:T:R:B] [--pid N]

exe.help: executable name of the window, for example AoE2DE_s.exe (regex)

out.help: base path (Windows or WSL path), writes .mkv, .audio.raw, and .json

crop.help: left:top:right:bottom px to cut (for example ultrawide to the 16:9 center)

pid.help: process to capture audio from, when --exe matches more than one (for example two java.exe)

reg.help: read or set registry values (set backs the key up first)
